description: ExioML is a machine-learning-ready data set built from the environmentally extended multi-regional input-output database EXIOBASE 3.8.2. It gives factor accounting tables of value added, employment, energy use and greenhouse gas emissions and footprint networks tracing resource flows between sectors, for 200 products and 163 industries in 49 regions for each year from 1995 to 2022. Yanming Guo, Charles Guan and Jin Ma of the University of Sydney and Rich Data Co introduced it at the ICLR 2024 Climate Change AI workshop, with a baseline emission regression task. Coverage is global in 49 regions. Format and access: data on Zenodo and a Python toolkit on GitHub and PyPI that loads tables, preprocesses features and splits data; compatible with pymrio. Licence: the code is Apache-2.0; the data licence was not read. Caveats: it inherits EXIOBASE's modelled estimates and sector aggregation. It supports network analysis of sectoral interdependencies and emissions in economic models of infrastructure. The related catalogue record is EXIOBASE 3, its source.
